decisions.decision: Token pipeline: Style Dictionary v4 with W3C DTCG JSON source

decisions.decision: SD Dart formatter: search community first before building from scratch
decisions.rationale: Could save days; pub.dev + GitHub search allocated before custom build

decisions.decision: All 4 type conversions need unit tests: Color hex→Color(0xFF), dimension→double, shadow→BoxShadow, lineHeight→multiplier
decisions.rationale: Silent failure modes; formatter correctness is load-bearing

decisions.decision: Custom formatter code lives in sd-transforms/ directory
decisions.rationale: Keeps pipeline logic separate from token source JSON and generated output

decisions.decision: Dart output: single voltventure_tokens.dart (not per-category barrel)
decisions.rationale: Simplest import pattern; fine for token-only scope

decisions.decision: Doc comments included in generated Dart file
decisions.rationale: IDE tooltips show token purpose without opening Storybook

decisions.decision: Primitive tokens private (_colorGreen500); only semantic tokens exported
decisions.rationale: Enforces three-tier architecture at Dart level; widgets cannot reach primitives directly
